observed.message: Снимок узла изменён или не соответствует пересчитанному результату.

expected_after: Serialization and actual JSON deserialization preserve typed input, exact gap text and snapshot digest. The original readonly snapshot must remain unchanged.
finding: Mono decimal-to-double conversion changes one low bit for this valid input. A newly created snapshot cannot read its own JSON. Digest correctly refuses the altered number; parsing must preserve the input, not weaken the digest.
scope: New unfinished ATFNODE increment; not a reopened legacy issue or live AutoCAD result.
